get_stub: get a gRPC stub for the model server at the given address
get_response: get a prediction response from the model server given a stub and screenshot PNG batch
get_pad_input: get a padded input PNG for empty image padding in batched requests
get_single_beam: get a single beam prediction from the model server for one screenshot
beam_to_str: convert a beam prediction object to a human-readable string for debugging
